data.raw_text:
Why USA might try to invade Kharg island and why it is a bad idea?

Up to 90% of Iran's oil exports, which include crude oil, fertilizers & LNG, pass through the terminal on Kharg, which is able to load 10 supertankers at once. This makes it very strategically significant. There is also storage for around 30 million barrels of oil on the island.

The loss of Kharg island would of course be an enormous hit to Iran's oil and LNG based economy. Iran’s ⁠parliament speaker had warned it would ‘abandon all restraint’ if there was US aggression against Iranian islands. We would most likely see attacks against US navy, but also at the oil & LNG infrastructure of the Gulf states hosting US military bases (UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and Saudi Arabia). 

Kharg island is located only 25 from the coast of Iran, making it within the range of standard artillery fire from 155 mm howitzers and Iran has plenty of MLRS systems, short range drones and rockets as well. This would put the US troops in the island at huge risk.

US military is supposed to protect its allies in the region, but past 2 weeks have shown that USA is mainly interested in protecting Israel at the cost of everything else. USA has already abandoned many its military bases in the region.

At this moment THAAD systems and elites marines are beind transferred from the East Asia to the Middle East. So good luck to Japan, South Korea, the Philippines and Taiwan and "thanks" for being an US ally?

An alternative plan for USA might be try to invade Larak, Hormuz ja Qeshem islands to block the Bandar Abbas harbor and maybe later even try ground invasion along the coastal areas near Bandar Abbas. This would be risky and would once again definitely trigger Iran to retaliate into the entire region.
